Application: Mark the launch point of every swing high

Key Rule: No sellers above = free will for buyers to push at max speed
Application: Trade in the direction of the open highway

Key Rule: Strong buyers force sellers to move out of the way
Analogy/Example: Lamborghini on highway — slow drivers move aside

Key Rule: Forex pairs move off news and economics — not investment flow
Application: Avoid Forex for day trading volatility

Application: Maps directly to all-time high price behavior

Application: Check the leader before trading the follower
